title: Kim v. Korean Capital Presbytery
disposition_detail: Complaint 2011-05 held administratively out of order because it was not filed with the Stated Clerk within 30 days after the lower court's October 4, 2010 meeting; adopted by roll call 18 concurring, 1 disqualified, 5 absent.
first_summary: The SJC dismissed Young Bae Kim's complaint against Korean Capital Presbytery as untimely because it was not filed with the Stated Clerk within 30 days after the presbytery's October 4, 2010 meeting. No merits ruling was reached. The adopted roll call was 18 concurring, 1 disqualified, and 5 absent.
summary: The SJC held Young Bae Kim's complaint against Korean Capital Presbytery administratively out of order because it was not filed with the Stated Clerk within 30 days after the presbytery's October 4, 2010 meeting, as BCO 43 requires. The adopted ruling reached no merits. The roll call adopted 18 concurring, 1 disqualified, and 5 absent; the disqualified commissioner could not certify that he had read the necessary record portions.
